title: Megurine Luka — Feelings From Each SEKAI〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Len, don't bring your marshmallow so close to the fire. It'll burn.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I know. You gotta take your time on these.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nom nom... Mmm! The outside is a little crispy, but the inside is sooo gooey and good! It's so sweet!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't get too close to the fire, and mind how hot the marshmallows get. Don't burn yourselves.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can't say I expected to be borrowing a camp stove from An and the others and toasting marshmallows tonight...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Can you blame us for being excited? Camping sounded like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If only we had some trees in this SEKAI, we could have a proper campout... Why is this place concrete as far as the eye can see?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We should be glad it's a city, I think. If it was a forest SEKAI, we'd be living off the land.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah... Yeah. That's a good point.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A lifestyle like that would be a terrible fit for my many good points.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My spirit of adventure and my boundless adaptability♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You mean your distractibility and flakiness?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You could put it that way if you really want to. Either way, when it comes to living life how I please, I have everyone in this SEKAI beat—

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I'd bet I beat out any other Luka from any other SEKAI, too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seems like that version of me is just as free-spirited as ever.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of any Luka across all SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Across all the SEKAI out there...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Any other Luka from any other SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I think I've begun to grasp what feelings this SEKAI was born from.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All that's left to check are... The show me, and the band me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll just have a little look at your memories, too...

rows.Speaker: Ducky Plushie
rows.Line: Luka, thanks for helping us become friends again.

rows.Speaker: Wood Duck Plushie
rows.Line: And thanks for listening to us too, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, are you feeling sleepy? Want to have a rest in the grass here?

rows.Speaker: Ducky Plushie
rows.Line: Leave this little one to us!

rows.Speaker: Wood Duck Plushie
rows.Line: Come on, let's go right home.

rows.Speaker: Chick Plushie
rows.Line:
Okay.
Luka, MEIKO, thank you! Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good work, Luka. First you help mend a friendship, then you're right off to rescue a lost little chick.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, it's been a long day...
Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, can I lie on your lap?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course. It's your reward for working so hard to help everyone smile.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe... I can hear everyone laughing and having fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm so lucky to get to drift to sleep hearing such wonderful sounds...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, were you looking at the cherry blossoms on the blackboard again?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes... The flowers we all drew together are just so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They really are. I would have liked to find some real cherry blossoms in this SEKAI too, but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, we never know. As their feelings keep growing and changing, maybe we will find some someday.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As their feelings keep growing... I wonder if it'll really be as easy as that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How long do you think that will take? Two years? Three?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's up to them, but it could take ten or even twenty years.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! Will I even be able to be a good mentor to them for that long?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No matter how much time passes, we'll manage it. You and me both.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I hope you're right...
But how can you sound so sure?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Because I know we'll both keep working hard to be good for them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: After all, we were born from their wholehearted and devoted feelings, for that very purpose.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Every time I touch on their feelings, and do my best to support and respond to them, I find myself thinking...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm so glad I was born to be this SEKAI's Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Each and every Luka, in each and every SEKAI, exists there and nowhere else...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And each of you is so proud of who you are and where you come from.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thanks to you all, I can be proud of who I am, too.
